## Peoples Security Bank & Trust Welcomes Scott Campagna as Executive Vice President, Chief Information Officer


10/27/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 153 KB](https://s203.q4cdn.com/756832046/files/doc_news/Peoples-Security-Bank--Trust-Welcomes-Scott-Campagna-as-Executive-Vice-President-Chief-Information-Officer-2026.pdf)


MOOSIC, Pa.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Peoples Financial Services Corp. ("PFIS" or the "Company") (NASDAQ: PFIS), the bank holding company for Peoples Security Bank and Trust Company (the "Bank"), announced today that Scott Campagna has joined the organization as Executive Vice President, Chief Information Officer.


Scott Campagna has joined Peoples Security Bank & Trust as Executive Vice President, Chief Information Officer


Campagna succeeds Susan Hubble, who will serve as Senior Executive Advisor to support the leadership transition until her retirement in April 2027, after more than 27 years with the Bank. Hubble joined the Bank in November 1999 as Systems Administrator and later served in senior information technology officer roles before becoming Chief Information Officer in December 2019. The Bank extends its sincere thanks to Susan for her service and wishes her all the best in retirement.


As Chief Information Officer, Campagna will lead the Bank’s technology strategy to enable growth, strengthen competitive advantage, and enhance customer experience. Partnering with executive leadership, he will work to drive operational efficiency, leverage AI and data to improve decision-making, and ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value while strengthening security, resilience, and regulatory compliance.


Campagna brings more than 25 years of technology and business leadership experience. Most recently, he served as a strategic advisor and fractional CIO through Primenet Systems, helping organizations align technology strategy with business objectives, modernize operations, and leverage AI to drive growth and efficiency. Previously, Campagna served as Chief Information Officer and Head of Operations at PeoplesBank, a Codorus Valley Company (York, PA) and subsequently as CIO of Orrstown Bank (Harrisburg, PA), leading enterprise transformation from 2016 to 2024. Earlier, he held senior technology leadership roles at Fulton Financial Corporation and Armstrong World Industries, with additional experience at Danaher and GSK.


Campagna earned a Master of Business Administration in international business from Temple University’s Fox School of Business and a Bachelor of Science in business and engineering, with a concentration in computer science, from Drexel University. He is also Six Sigma Green Belt and Lean Practitioner certified.


“Scott brings a strong combination of banking experience, technology leadership and operational expertise to Peoples Security Bank & Trust,” said Jerry Champi, President & CEO. “His ability to align technology and operations, advance innovation and strengthen governance will be important as we continue to enhance customer experience, improve efficiency and position the company for long-term growth.”


“I’m excited to join Peoples Security Bank & Trust and work alongside a talented team committed to its customers and communities. I look forward to building on the Bank’s strong foundation and utilizing technology to contribute to sustainable growth, exceptional service and lasting value,” said Campagna.


**About Peoples Financial Services Corp.**


Peoples Financial Services Corp. is the bank holding company of Peoples Security Bank and Trust Company, an independent community bank serving its retail and commercial customers through 40 full-service community banking offices located within Allegheny, Bucks, Lackawanna, Lancaster, Lebanon, Lehigh, Luzerne, Monroe, Montgomery, Northampton, Susquehanna, Wayne and Wyoming Counties in Pennsylvania, Middlesex County in New Jersey and Broome County in New York. Each office, interdependent with the community, offers a comprehensive array of financial products and services to individuals, businesses, not-for-profit organizations, and government entities. Peoples' business philosophy includes offering direct access to senior management and other officers and providing friendly, informed and courteous service, and local and timely decision making.
